title: Universal Weather Node — history (/api/history?range=24h|7d)
description: In-RAM history as parallel arrays, oldest first: element i of every value array belongs to ageSec[i]. 24h: 5-min buckets (max 288 = 24 h); 7d: 1-h buckets (max 168 = 7 days) — fixed windows (wall clock once synced, else uptime), one point per window, a cycle counts in the window it ends in. The last element with ageSec 0 is the still-open bucket (a live preview). null = no data in that bucket (sensor off/absent, or no cycle in that window when cycles are longer than the bucket) — draw a gap, never a 0. All arrays and unit fields are always present. Cleared by a restart. Stability: within apiVersion 1 fields are only added.

items.description: Seconds between the end of the bucket and this response.

ageSec.description: Age of every bucket's end, decreasing (oldest first) in steps of bucketSec (/api/info history.ranges). Timestamp of point i = time of your request − ageSec[i]; bucket i covers the bucketSec before that.

windGust.description: Highest gust per bucket (maximum, not mean).

windDirDeg.description: Last valid wind direction in the bucket (degrees from north; not averaged).

rainMm.description: Rain amount per bucket (sum — add them up for totals). Despite the name in rainUnit (in when imperial).

temp.description: Mean air temperature per bucket (selected source).

pressureQnh.description: Mean sea-level pressure per bucket (selected pressure source).

uvSensorVolts.description: Mean board UV sensor voltage per bucket (PCB v2.0).

uvIndex.description: Mean UV index per bucket (wireless or calibrated board input).

ds18b20_0.description: Mean temperature of DS18B20 probe slot 0 (= /api/data ds18b20[0]).

ds18b20_1.description: Mean temperature of DS18B20 probe slot 1.

ds18b20_2.description: Mean temperature of DS18B20 probe slot 2.

series.description: Custom series (Settings -> Sensors -> Custom series), one object per defined series; values aligned with ageSec. Temperatures in tempUnit.
series.x-present: only with at least one custom series

slot.description: Slot number on the settings page.

unit.description: Unit of the values; absent if none (e.g. lightning strikes, UV index).

perBucket.description: true = a count per bucket (lightning strikes), not a level; the range total is their sum.

values.description: One value per bucket, aligned with ageSec; null = no value.
